description: This is a Java source class for a REST controller named OrderRESTController, which handles HTTP requests related to order operations in a web shop. It provides endpoints for creating orders and fetching lists of orders, optionally filtered by customer or store. The class interacts with various services such as OrderService, CustomerService, and others to perform business logic and persistence.

classes.name: OrderRESTController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller providing REST endpoints for creating and retrieving orders.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order for a specified store, populating customer info and order details, then saving and returning the persisted order.

methods.name: listOrders (GET /{store}/orders/)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders for a store with optional filtering by language, start index, and maximum count.

methods.name: listOrders (GET /{store}/orders/customer/{id})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders associated with a specific customer ID for a store, with optional filtering.
